title: Psalm emits this issue when incrementing a non-numeric string ($a = "a"; $a++; gives "b").
summary: This works in PHP, but is unexpected behaviour for most people, and it is deprecated as of PHP 8.5: use str_increment() (available since PHP 8.3) instead. The issue is emitted whatever the PHP version the code is analysed for. Psalm ignores it at error level 5 and higher.
